app.name: Munim
app.tagline: Checks a supplier's papers and works out the interest a late buyer owes under the MSMED Act.

rule.GSTIN-FORMAT: The GSTIN must be 15 characters: 2 digits, 5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter, then 3 more characters.
rule.GSTIN-STATE: The first two digits {code} are not a state code.
rule.GSTIN-CHECKSUM: The last character doesn't match the other 14 characters. Check the GSTIN on the paper.
rule.GSTIN-LOOKALIKE: This GSTIN passes only after a look-alike character was changed. Compare it with the paper.
rule.GSTIN-PAN: The PAN inside the GSTIN ({pan_gstin}) differs from the PAN printed on the paper ({pan_paper}).
rule.PAN-FORMAT: A PAN is 10 characters: 5 letters, 4 digits and 1 letter.
rule.UDYAM-FORMAT: The Udyam number {printed} isn't in the form UDYAM-XX-00-0000000.
rule.VALUE-FORMAT.amount: {printed} can't be read as an amount. Enter the amount printed on the paper.
rule.VALUE-FORMAT.date: {printed} can't be read as a date. Enter the date printed on the paper.
rule.VALUE-FORMAT.quantity: {printed} can't be read as a quantity. Enter the number printed on the paper.
rule.VALUE-FORMAT.number: {printed} can't be read as a number of days.
rule.VALUE-FORMAT.runaway: The reader wrote far too much here, so the value was dropped. Enter it from the paper.
rule.INV-LINE-AMOUNT: Line {n}: quantity times rate is {computed}, but the amount is {printed}.
rule.INV-TAXABLE-SUM: The lines add up to {computed}, but the taxable total is {printed}.
rule.INV-TAX-SPLIT: The supplier and buyer are in {same_or_different}, so the tax should be {expected}.
rule.INV-TAX-SPLIT.place_of_supply: The place of supply {printed} differs from the buyer's state. Check which tax applies.
rule.INV-TAX-RATE: The tax works out to {rate_percent}% of the taxable value. Check the rate printed for this item.
rule.INV-TOTAL: Taxable value plus tax is {computed}, but the invoice total is {printed}.
rule.INV-NUMBER-FORMAT: The invoice number {printed} is longer than 16 characters or uses characters GST invoices don't allow.
rule.INV-DATE-SANE: The invoice date {read} is in the future or implausibly old.
rule.DATE-AMBIGUOUS: The date {printed} can be read as {a} or {b}. Enter it with the month in words.
rule.X-SUPPLIER-GSTIN: The supplier's GSTIN is {a} on the {a_paper} but {b} on the {b_paper}.
rule.X-BUYER-GSTIN: The buyer's GSTIN is {a} on the {a_paper} but {b} on the {b_paper}.
rule.X-NAME-SIMILAR: The {role} is named "{a}" on the {a_paper} and "{b}" on the {b_paper}. Check they are the same business.
rule.X-INVOICE-REF: The challan names invoice {on_challan}, but this invoice is {on_invoice}.
rule.X-PO-REF: The {paper} names purchase order {on_paper}, but the purchase order is {on_po}.
rule.X-QTY: Line "{item}": the challan says {challan_qty}, the invoice says {invoice_qty}.
rule.X-QTY.unit: Line "{item}": the challan says {challan_qty} and the invoice says {invoice_qty}, in units that can't be compared.
rule.X-QTY.unmatched: Line "{item}" isn't on the challan. Check the delivered goods.
rule.X-DATE-ORDER.po_challan: The challan date {challan_date} is before the purchase order date {po_date}.
rule.X-DATE-ORDER.invoice_challan: The challan date {challan_date} is more than 30 days after the invoice date {invoice_date}.
rule.X-DATE-ORDER.after_as_on: The delivery date {acceptance_date} is after the date interest is worked out to ({as_on_date}).
rule.X-RECEIVER-ACK: No receiver's stamp or signature found. The delivery date may be disputed.

working.title: How this is worked out
working.intro: Every step below follows sections 15 and 16 of the MSMED Act, 2006, as set out in the rules page. Amounts are in rupees; each month's interest is rounded to the paisa.
elig.title: Who the Act protects
elig.body: The Act's protection applies to micro and small suppliers. Courts have taken different views on whether the registration must exist on the date the contract was made. The Supreme Court in NBCC (India) Ltd v State of West Bengal (January 2025) held that prior registration is not mandatory for a Section 18 reference, and referred the point to a larger bench. Earlier decisions (Silpi Industries, 2021; Mahakali Foods, 2023) took the opposite view. Check with a lawyer or your industry association before filing.

about.title: About Munim
about.what: Munim reads photos of a tax invoice, a delivery challan and a purchase order with the Gemma 4 model, checks them with fixed rules, and works out the payment clock and interest under the MSMED Act, 2006. It prints an evidence file and a draft notice.
about.model: The model only copies what is printed and marks where. Every check, number and sentence you see is decided by Munim's own code.
about.privacy: Your papers stay on this computer unless you choose the hosted reader. Munim sends nothing anywhere else.
about.licence: Munim is open source under the `Apache License 2.0`. Gemma 4 is used under the Gemma terms of use. The fonts are Mukta and Kalam under the `SIL Open Font License`.
legal.notice: Munim reads and calculates. It does not give legal advice and does not file anything. Check with a lawyer, a chartered accountant or your industry association before relying on a figure or sending a notice.
